notes.subject: בצר
notes.rationale: This form occurs only here; lexicon glosses 'gold', but the sense line reads distress (narrowness) — kept literal.

notes.subject: מאמצי
notes.rationale: Plural 'efforts/exertions' occurs only here in the Tanakh.

notes.subject: שועך
notes.rationale: Homograph: 'your cry' (S1) vs 'your wealth' (S2) — the whole line's meaning pivots on which is meant.

notes.subject: היערך…לא בצר
notes.rationale: Word order and negation are knotted: 'will your cry avail, that you not be in distress?' vs 'will he regard your wealth without distress?'; rendered word-for-word to leave the difficulty visible.

translation: Will he set in order your cry — is it not in distress — and all the efforts of strength?
